subject: Intermittent control plane retries during private net upgrade — coordination & commitments
messages:
From: monitoring@redwood-inference.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ALERT: Privatenet control-plane retry spike (lumen-care-prod)

Automated alert: We observed a 5x increase in control-plane RPC retries for LumenCare private deployment in us-west-2 between 08:45 and 09:05 PDT. Latency spikes correlated with node restarts during a rolling agent upgrade.

Summary:
- Impact: intermittent API errors for a subset of customers behind the LumenCare VPC (rate-limited requests returned 503/504).
- Approx. affected requests: ~1.2k (per-minute burst).
- Initial suspicion: upgrade agent retry loop + transient leader election delay.

Next steps recommended: paging on-call for Privatenet infra, notify account team to prepare customer comms.

--
Redwood Monitoring
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: asha@lumen-care.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ALERT: Privatenet control-plane retry spike (lumen-care-prod)

Asha —

Thanks for patience — we saw the alert on our side and have engineers actively investigating. Quick summary for transparency: we identified the issue during a scheduled agent rollout that started at 08:30 PDT. A subset of controller agents entered a retry loop following a graceful restart where election handshakes took longer than expected. That caused intermittent 503s for some requests routed through the control plane.

We have the following immediate actions in place:
- Rolled back the agent upgrade on the remaining nodes in the pool (complete).
- Stabilized leader election timeouts to avoid repeated retries (mitigation applied).
- Gathering detailed connectivity logs and a diagnostic bundle for your team.

We'd like to schedule a short bridge at 10:15 PDT to walk through the impact and next steps. Is that time OK for you and the ops team?

Apologies for the interruption — we know this is disruptive and are focused on ensuring it doesn't recur.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0118
From: asha@lumen-care.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: rajiv@lumen-care.com, tom.ops@lumen-care.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ALERT: Privatenet control-plane retry spike (lumen-care-prod)

Tessa —

Thank you for the quick update. 10:15 PDT works — Tom and I will join the bridge. Please include the logs you mentioned and any temporary runbook items we should apply in case we see recurrence. Our production traffic recovered around 09:20 after your rollback, but we saw a few timeouts in logs through 09:30.

We appreciate the fast rollback. From our side, minimizing impact during scheduled upgrades is critical — will want a postmortem and clear remediation plan.

Asha Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
LumenCare
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com, asha@lumen-care.com
Cc: support@cloudops.example
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-bridge: root cause, short-term fixes, and long-term remediation

Notes from 10:15 bridge (recap + action items):

Root cause (investigation summary):
- During the agent upgrade, controller processes were restarted on a 30s cadence on a subset of instances.
- A scheduling bug in the new agent caused ephemeral leader election delays (~12–18s) under peak control-plane load. Elections delayed longer than our backoff window, which triggered repeated RPC retries from the control-plane client library.
- Retries amplified the load and caused transient 503/504 responses for in-flight sessions that required control-plane handshakes, affecting a limited set of LumenCare traffic paths.

Immediate mitigations applied:
1) Agent rollout halted and upgraded nodes rolled back (complete at ~09:15 PDT).
2) Election timeout increased by 50% for the control-plane leader lock to avoid false positives in unstable conditions.
3) Short-term throttle added to client-side retry logic to prevent amplified retry storms.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Marcus Lin: deliver diagnostic bundle and connectivity logs to LumenCare (attached) — ETA: 2027-07-19 15:00 PDT.
- Ben Carter: prepare a formal postmortem and remediation plan covering the scheduling bug, test coverage, and release gating — ETA: 2027-07-21 EOD.
- Tessa Morgan: coordinate a follow-up call with LumenCare to review the postmortem and proposed SLA credit — ETA: 2027-07-22.
- Evelyn Hart: run a canary matrix test for agent upgrades across varying control-plane load before the next rollout — ETA: 2027-07-26.

Temporary customer-facing runbook items (for LumenCare ops):
- If you observe repeated 503s: pause any in-progress agent rollout and open a bridge to Redwood.
- For manual mitigation: a short delay (30–45s) before retrying a session restores normal flow in most cases.

Attachments: connectivity-logs-2027-07-19.zip, privatenet-diagnostic-runbook-v1.pdf

We recognize this caused customer disruption. We're proposing a one-time service credit for the impacted window; will confirm amount in the postmortem.

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Software Engineer, Privatenet
Redwood Inference
